title: Sodium Nitrite: FDA Status, IARC Processed Meat Classification & Regulatory Intelligence
excerpt: Comprehensive regulatory intelligence on sodium nitrite (E250), covering FDA prior-sanctioned status under 21 CFR 181.34, USDA-FSIS limits, IARC Group 1 processed meat classification, EU 2023/2108 lower limits effective October 2025, nitrosamine formation concerns, and the 'uncured' labeling controversy.

seo_description: Regulatory intelligence on sodium nitrite (E250, CAS 7632-00-0): FDA prior-sanctioned status, IARC processed meat classification, EU 2023/2108 lower limits, pending US reassessment legislation, and the celery powder labeling controversy.
